transport.source: actual socket IP; precise existing browser Origin policy
transport.oversize: explicit MESSAGE_TOO_LARGE_USE_M5; no truncation or partial mutation

request.operation_intent: immutable method and full business body; socket/session/reconnect IDs are not business identity
request.ownership: network:<actual peer IP>, preserving current HTTPS operation receipt semantics; not an authenticated user

database.engine: existing unified SQLite database, WAL, synchronous=FULL
database.receipt_storage: immutable legacy_snapshots extension records in the same business transaction; reserved sourceOrigin daty-mqtt-stage4
database.commit: business projection, versions, audit, native receipt and RPC receipt commit together
database.conflicts: preserve existing expected_revision, epoch, import preview digest, draft head and atomic batch rules
database.query: operations.get returns M4 outcome; database.operations.get preserves original native receipt DTO
database.history: same high-water cursor, immutable versions, tombstones, source JSON and original scan units
database.alerts: unchanged <=200 per batch; confirmed ids/revisions/epoch; no deletion of new lifecycle, Timeline or immutable audit
database.stored_channels: historical persistence projection, not online/control identity; existing keyset pages preserved; displays retain real GROUP/CH sorting

discovery.scope: existing server-owned Shure read-only discovery; client cannot select arbitrary hosts or ports
discovery.precondition: expected_generation; cancel also requires exact scan_operation_id
discovery.start: persist dispatch claim before starting once
discovery.receipt_semantics: accepted is not scan complete; cancel_requested is not cancellation complete
discovery.recovery: interrupted accepted/dispatching becomes unknown, never auto-rescan; unresolved scan blocks another scan
discovery.completion: persist final generation, actual snapshot and error before reporting completed

native.response_shape: status and original JSON DTO; no HTTP networking behind the injected port
native.permanent_display_order: actual numeric GROUP ascending, then numeric CH ascending, unknown last; sort complete display set before paging

not_in_stage4: production deployment or live receiver control
file transfer, archive lifecycle and pairing renewal over MQTT (M5)
manual resolution of an interrupted uncertain discovery operation
browser window/background freeze or physical Shure hardware acceptance
